note: Semantic losses that occur when this seat's lane outputs are projected into the UIOWA-023 evidence register. Each one is declared because the register has no enum that carries the distinction. An undeclared collapse fails conformance.py.

declared.why: The register's evidence_state enum has one value for 'nothing observed'. The inventory distinguishes a use that has not started, a use asserted with nothing behind it, and a record too incomplete to classify. Those are three different next actions.
declared.preserved_as: the source classification is written verbatim into scope_limit, so the distinction survives at row level even though the enum cannot hold it
declared.direction: neutral: none of the three is made to look better or worse than the source says

declared.why: A working figure with nothing behind it and no figure at all are different states. The register cannot separate them.
declared.preserved_as: the source basis is written verbatim into scope_limit
declared.direction: neutral: ASSUMED is not promoted to SUPPORTING on the strength of having a number

verified_survivals.why: The register carries EVIDENCE_OF_ABSENCE separately from NO_EVIDENCE_OBSERVED, which is exactly the unresolved-ownership versus missing-evidence distinction 108 makes. Nothing is lost, and the register's own rule then requires universe_definition, enumerator_authority and completeness_basis, which the packet can supply.
A record declared PLANNED that arrives carrying output projects to CONFLICTING, and the register then forces UNRESOLVED confidence plus a conflict_group. The status/evidence mismatch survives intact.
